newsitem.title: USA: DeKalb Genetics up on earnings surprise.
newsitem.headline: DeKalb Genetics up on earnings surprise.

text.p: Shares of DeKalb Genetics Corp rose 4-3/4 to 78-1/2 after the agricultural company reported stronger than expected third quarter earnings.
Volume was about 144,000 shares in composite trading.
"We see dramatic earnings growth ahead for DeKalb," Natwest Securities analyst Mark Wiltamuth said.
DeKalb reported earnings for the third quarter ended May 31 of $0.73 a share, up from $0.51 a year earlier. Most analysts had expected earnings of about $0.65 a share.
Earnings were boosted by momentum in the company's seed corn business.
Piper Jaffray analyst George Dahlman said DeKalb likely saw an increase in its share of the North American seed corn market, based on DeKalb's report that its corn sales volume rose five percent.
Wiltamuth estimates DeKalb's corn market share at 11.5 percent, up from about 11 percent last year.
DeKalb said it expects to report a small loss for the fiscal fourth quarter, which is typical given the seasonality of the seed business.
Analysts said the size of the loss will depend largely on the performance of DeKalb's swine business.
